features: Universal Compatibility for Effortless Connectivity: Easily connect your USB-C devices — including smartphones, tablets, external drives, and more — to standard USB-A ports on laptops, desktops, gaming consoles, and car systems. Enjoy seamless plug-and-play compatibility across all devices.
Blazing-Fast 5Gbps Data Transfer: Transfer large files, videos, or backups in seconds with USB 3.0 technology. Experience smooth, high-speed data transfers that keep your workflow fast and efficient.
Fast & Reliable Charging up to 15W: Power up your USB-C devices quickly and safely. The adapter supports up to 15W charging for stable, dependable performance without overheating or lag.
Premium Aluminium Alloy Build: Built from high-grade aluminium alloy for superior strength and long-lasting durability. Resistant to daily wear and tear while maintaining a sleek, professional look.
Compact & Ultra-Portable Design: Lightweight and pocket-sized, this adapter is perfect for travel or everyday use. Carry it easily in your bag, wallet, or laptop sleeve for on-the-go convenience.
